title: Grammar: I wish / If only / Would rather
grammarTip:
Wish, if only и would rather — "сдвиг времени назад":

WISH/IF ONLY для настоящего → используй Past Simple:
"I wish I knew the answer." (знать сейчас → knew)
"If only she were here." (быть сейчас → were)

WISH/IF ONLY для прошлого → используй Past Perfect:
"I wish I had studied harder." (учиться раньше → had studied)
"If only I hadn't said that." (не говорить → hadn't said)

WOULD RATHER + base form (для чужих действий — Past Simple):
"I'd rather you didn't smoke here." (предпочёл бы что ты не...)
"I'd rather they came tomorrow." (предпочёл бы что они...)

grammarExtra.title: Wish + would: Annoyance or Request for Change

rows.example: I wish it would stop raining.
I wish you would listen more carefully.

rows.form: Note: Cannot say "I wish I would"

rows.example: If only I had more confidence!
If only I had accepted the offer.

rows.form: If only can stand alone (no result clause)

rows.example: I'd rather you came tomorrow, not today.
I'd rather she hadn't mentioned it.

rows.form: For same subject: I'd rather + bare infinitive

rows.example: It's time you made a decision.

rows.form: It's high time + subject + past simple
Meaning: The action should happen NOW or SOON
rows.example: It's time you apologised to her.

rows.form: ❌ I wish I would have more money.
rows.example: ✅ I wish I had more money.

rows.form: ❌ If only I didn't say that.
rows.example: ✅ If only I hadn't said that. (past perfect for past)

rows.form: ❌ I'd rather you will come tomorrow.

exercises.text: "I wish I ___ a car." (I don't have one now)
exercises.hint: Wish + past simple = present impossible wish

exercises.text: "If only she ___ the email earlier." (She sent it too late)
exercises.hint: If only + past perfect = past regret

exercises.instruction: Complete with the correct form of the verb in brackets.
exercises.text: "I wish you ___ (not/interrupt) me all the time." (annoying habit — wish + would)
exercises.hint: Wish + would for change requests / annoyance

exercises.text: Which sentence expresses a past regret correctly?
opts: I wish I didn't take that job.
I wish I hadn't taken that job.
I wish I wouldn't take that job.
I wish I don't take that job.
exercises.correct: I wish I hadn't taken that job.

exercises.text: "I'd rather you ___ (not/tell) anyone about this." (preference about another person)
exercises.hint: Would rather + different subject + past simple

exercises.text: I wish the weather were better. → If ___ the weather ___ better!
exercises.hint: "If only" replaces "I wish" — same grammar rules

exercises.text: "I'd rather ___ tonight." (Same subject — prefer to stay home)
exercises.hint: Same subject: I'd rather + bare infinitive

exercises.text: "I wish it ___ (stop) raining — it's been going on for days!" (Annoying ongoing situation)
exercises.hint: Wish + would + verb = change request / annoyance

opts: I wish I knew the answer.
If only I had arrived earlier.
I wish I would have more free time.
It's time you went to bed.
exercises.correct: I wish I would have more free time.
exercises.hint: Cannot say "wish I would" — use "wish I had"

exercises.text: "___ I known about the problem, I would have acted immediately." (= If I had known)
exercises.hint: Inverted conditional: Had + subject + past participle

exercises.text: "I'd rather you ___ smoking in this room."
exercises.hint: Would rather + different subject + past simple negative

exercises.text: "She doesn't speak French." → She wishes she ___ French.
exercises.hint: Wish + past simple for present impossible wish

exercises.text: "I wish you would be more organised."
opts: I am glad you are organised
I am annoyed at your lack of organisation
I hope you will organise something soon
I think you should organise an event
exercises.correct: I am annoyed at your lack of organisation
exercises.hint: Wish + would = annoyance / request for change

exercises.text: "If the report had been submitted on time, there would have been no problems." → ___ the report ___ submitted on time, there would have been no problems.
exercises.hint: Drop "if," move "had" to front: "Had the report been..."

exercises.instruction: Choose the correct form for "It's time."

questions.text: "I wish I ___ to the party." (I didn't go — past regret)
"If only she ___ harder." (She doesn't work hard now)
questions.hint: If only + past simple = present wish/regret

questions.text: "I'd rather you ___ (not/come) tomorrow — I'll be busy."
questions.hint: Would rather + different subject + past simple negative

questions.text: Which sentence expresses annoyance about a habit?
opts: I wish I had been more careful.
I wish you would stop making that noise.
If only I had more time.
questions.correct: I wish you would stop making that noise.

questions.text: "It's high time we ___ something about the problem."
"I wish I would have a car" is grammatically correct.
questions.hint: Cannot use "wish + I would" — use "wish + I had"

questions.text: "___ they consulted us earlier, the project would have succeeded." (Formal inverted conditional)
questions.hint: "Had" moves to front in inverted conditional

questions.text: "I'd rather stay home tonight." — What is the subject of "stay"?
questions.hint: Same subject: I'd rather + bare infinitive

questions.text: "She ___ she had listened to her teacher's advice." (She didn't listen — past regret)
questions.hint: Wish + past perfect for past regret

questions.text: Which is NOT a correct use of "if only"?
opts: If only I will try harder!
If only the rain would stop!
questions.correct: If only I will try harder!
questions.hint: "Will" after "if only" is not used — use past tense backshift

questions.text: "I'd rather you hadn't mentioned that." — What does this mean?
opts: I prefer that you don't mention it in the future
I regret that you mentioned it (past)
I am glad you mentioned it
I want you to mention it again
questions.correct: I regret that you mentioned it (past)
questions.hint: Would rather + subject + past perfect = past preference/regret
